desc:
Merge animals and evolve them from a tiny Mouse all the way up to the Eclipse Dragon! 🐉

Carry an animal into its match to merge them into something bigger. 60 animals to discover, and your pen keeps earning cash even while you're offline.

Rebirth to unlock bigger animals and earn faster
Raid other bases and knock out their defenders for cash
Fight the Ancient Titan with the whole server every 20 minutes
Battle through 300 Adventure levels with your strongest animals
Train on your treadmill for a cash boost that never runs out
Come back daily for gifts, with an OP animal on day 7

Better with friends: every friend in your server gives you +10% cash, and if you invite someone new you both get a free animal.

Like the game and join our group for extra cash. New animals are on the way!
